caption: The drawing features a square section with a beige background. Within this square, there are five large, stylized leaf motifs that are blue with white highlights, arranged in a diamond pattern, with one in the center and the other four near each corner. Connecting these motifs are diagonal lines of small black and gray flowers with thin, branching stems, forming a repeating diamond lattice around the blue motifs. The edges of the drawing are bordered by a white margin.
title: Wallpaper
